name: ego_network
author: e1e14ad1
description: Builds the ego network of one node: the node, its immediate (1-hop) neighbours and every edge among them. Use for 'show me X's immediate network' and 'who is directly connected to X?'. For 2+ hops use k_hop_neighborhood. Works on directed and undirected graphs; on directed graphs 'direction' picks which neighbours count. Edge weights are ignored. Returns the neighbour count, the number of nodes and edges in the ego network, a sample of neighbours (top_k, sorted by id) and result_graph_id, the registered subgraph another tool can run on.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Node id of the centre (the ego), e.g. 'MAA' or 'm1'. Use lookup_node to find the id from a name.

direction.description: Directed graphs only: which nodes count as neighbours. 'out' = nodes the ego points to, 'in' = nodes pointing to the ego, 'both' = either (default 'both'). Edge counts include all edges among the chosen nodes, in either direction. Ignored for undirected graphs.

top_k.description: How many neighbours to list in neighbor_sample (default 10, maximum 100). The neighbour count is always the full number.
